title: Ted Williams 1992 Upper Deck #33 Baseball Heroes 1950s Player Of The Decade
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 1992 Upper Deck trading card featuring baseball legend Ted Williams, known as the Player of the Decade in the 1950s. This card is part of the Baseball Heroes series, specifically numbered as #33, and is manufactured by Upper Deck. It is a sports trading card sought after by collectors interested in baseball memorabilia.
